analysis:
Examined ProviderLoop.swift base lines 544-1116 and head lines 1-543. The change map is marked complete. It adds two stored properties.

(1) Head line 445 adds `loadWeightHasher`. It is an injectable seam defaulting to WeightHasher.computeHash and is used by captureWeightHash for load-time hash captures. It mirrors the existing modelSwitchWeightHasher seam. The default behavior is the same full hash, so this file shows no weakening.

(2) Head ~688 adds `verifiedWeightHashesFile: URL?`. It is the location of a VerifiedWeightHashStore that persists verified managed-load hashes for the next start's registration. It is nil until run() serves with host services.

Security relevance (T-012, T-027, T-034, A-004): persisting weight hashes across restarts and reusing them at registration could let an operator-writable file (TB-003, ADV-001) supply registered models[].weight_hash values. Those values would not be recomputed against the current on-disk weights.

The safety of this depends on code not in this batch:
- VerifiedWeightHashStore: file permissions, and whether it binds the stored hash to a snapshot fingerprint (paths, sizes, mtimes) and invalidates it on mismatch.
- The registration path in ProviderLoop+Serve and ProviderLoop+ModelLoading that consumes it.
- Whether attestation challenge responses (active_model_hash, from liveModelHashes) still come from real computation.

The coordinator-side weight-hash cross-check is the authoritative control. Per A-004 notes, that check is partly fail-open (SEC-007), so a stale or forged persisted hash could matter.

A persisted hash would be self-reported provider data either way, much like the existing loaded-models.json and modelHashFingerprints seeding. No concrete regression is visible in these units.

Integration should verify:
- The write and read paths of VerifiedWeightHashStore.
- The fingerprint binding of stored hashes.
- That registration does not prefer a persisted hash over a freshly computed one in a way that bypasses failedSelfTestHashes or the model-swap checks.

The other content is unchanged: SendHandle ordering, the attestation signer fallback, and init.
